WITH account_order_counts AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as order_count
  FROM `order`
  GROUP BY account_id
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_count
  FROM account_order_counts
),
above_avg_accounts AS (
  SELECT aoc.account_id, aoc.order_count
  FROM account_order_counts aoc, overall_avg oa
  WHERE aoc.order_count > oa.avg_count
),
above_avg_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_above
  FROM above_avg_accounts
)
SELECT 
  aaa.account_id,
  aaa.order_count,
  aaa.order_count - oa.avg_count as above_overall_avg,
  aaa.order_count - aam.avg_above as above_above_avg
FROM above_avg_accounts aaa, overall_avg oa, above_avg_mean aam
ORDER BY above_above_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
